dialogues.speaker: Elowen
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Knight. *gasp* ...Elowen, you're doing great, you're not nervous at all... *inhale* Take a deep breath, think about what you're going to say...

choices.text: Why don't you tell me something about yourself?

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: M—Me? I'm just an ordinary knight, and I'm good at... Well, actually, there's nothing I'm particularly good at, but there are things I'm particularly bad at.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: For example, muskets are so complicated... No matter how hard I try, I can't seem to maintain them properly. Ugh... There are so many steps that only Koch can remember them all! Oh, by the way, Koch is the gunsmith at Dornman Port...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: That's why I prefer traditional weapons to muskets... They're not only easier to handle, but also much easier to maintain...

choices.text: What do you think of Tres?

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Tres? He's a nice person... In every aspect. He's a capable worker, a quick learner, and also has a great personality.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Coworker, superior, or subordinate — he's a person you'd want to work with, regardless of capacity.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: It's just that... he still struggles with confidence sometimes, just as Mika does... It's a bit ironic, considering he scored exceptionally well on this year's combat test.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: *sigh* Unlike him, I actually failed my "Basic Mechanism Dismantling" exam... Even though the subject is mostly only useful for ruining mechanisms... It still worries me a bit.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: I can only hope for better luck in next year's test. As long as I scrape through, I'll be satisfied.

choices.text: Tell me, what do you do on a day-to-day basis?

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Compared to your experiences, Honorary Knight, what we do on a regular basis probably sounds less flashy...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: We spend most of our time patrolling and observing, and there may be a few intense battles here and there... For me, though, the biggest headache comes when we're picking someone to do the cooking...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: We use dice, so it's supposed to be a random event, right? But I lose eight times out of ten! *sigh* If only I could be that lucky in other areas...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Recently, the Logistics Company provided us with "Standard Field Rations," comprising five cans and nine paper packets. Everyone else complained they were incredibly salty...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: But I actually like them. At least, they're fuss-free when we're out in the field.

choices.text: Take your time, you don't need to rush...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: ...O—Okay... *sob*... When will I finally get over this habit of getting nervous so easily?
